tools.name: shop_links
tools.description: AMSOIL product links with dealer referral zo=30734402 for up to 25 product codes, plus the storefront link. The user opens each link, chooses the package size, and checks out on AMSOIL.

tools.name: nearest_distribution_centers
tools.description: The three closest AMSOIL distribution centers in the same country as a U.S. ZIP code or Canadian postal code, by straight-line distance. These are AMSOIL facilities, not A1 locations, and the nearest one may not fulfill an order.

tools.name: contact_dealer
tools.description: How to reach Jeff Pittman, the independent AMSOIL dealer behind A1 Synthetic Oil, and what to include when asking for help choosing a product or account.
